title: Status Page v2 – Component Signals & Thresholds (working spreadsheet)
content:
Notes / how to read this sheet
- Purpose: define what internal signals can drive customer-visible component status for Status Page v2 (Hosted API / Streaming / Embeddings / Reranking / Console / Dedicated control-plane signals) at region granularity.
- This is a working sheet used by SRE + Observability while building the component registry + signal mapping layer.
- Guardrails (per customer-facing-status-signals-standard):
  - Prefer error-rate + availability signals. Latency-only degradations must meet stricter persistence rules.
  - Avoid flap: require persistence + hysteresis + cooldown before auto-updating component state.
  - Do not encode customer-specific capacity issues; only product capability + region.

Proposed global defaults (applies unless overridden per component)
- Aggregation: by component_id, region, capability (labels must match status component taxonomy)
- Evaluation cadence: 60s
- Anti-flap:
  - trigger_after: 5m sustained breach (or 2 consecutive 3m windows)
  - resolve_after: 10m sustained healthy
  - hysteresis: recover threshold is 20% better than trigger threshold (e.g., 0.8% to recover from 1.0%)
  - cooldown_after_state_change: 15m (no additional automated state toggles)
- Burn-rate windows (SLO-based): 5m, 30m, 2h
  - page-worthy (Sev2/Sev1 candidate): 5m > 14x AND 30m > 7x
  - sustained incident: 30m > 7x AND 2h > 3x

Tab: Component Registry (excerpt)
component_id | display_name | region | capability | owner_team | notes
hosted_api.chat.us-east-1 | Hosted API – Chat – US East | us-east-1 | chat | eng-runtime | Includes /v1/chat and legacy chat routes. Excludes embeddings + rerank.
hosted_api.chat.eu-west-1 | Hosted API – Chat – EU West | eu-west-1 | chat | eng-runtime | 
hosted_api.streaming.us-east-1 | Hosted API – Streaming – US East | us-east-1 | streaming | eng-runtime | Streaming websocket/SSE response path; disconnects are primary failure mode.
hosted_api.embeddings.us-east-1 | Hosted API – Embeddings – US East | us-east-1 | embeddings | eng-runtime | Vectorization endpoints.
hosted_api.rerank.us-east-1 | Hosted API – Reranking – US East | us-east-1 | rerank | eng-runtime | Reranking endpoints.
console.web.global | Redwood Console – Web App | global | console | product-console-rollouts | Public console availability; does not reflect customer model runtime health.
dedicated.control_plane.global | Dedicated – Control Plane | global | dedicated_cp | eng-platform | Provisioning, routing config propagation, scaling actions.
statuspage.delivery.global | Status Update Delivery | global | statuspage | eng-sre | Ability to publish updates + page render health.

Tab: Signals & thresholds (main)
Columns: component_id | primary signal source | metric/query | trigger: degraded performance | trigger: partial outage | trigger: major outage | burn-rate (SLO) | dashboards | runbook link | anti-flap overrides | comments

hosted_api.chat.us-east-1 | Prometheus (gateway) | api_gateway_requests_total{capability="chat",region="us-east-1"} + errors via status_code | error_rate >= 1.0% for 5m OR p95_latency_ms >= 2.5x baseline for 10m | error_rate >= 5.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 25% for 3m OR 5xx >= 10% and request volume >= minQPS | 5m>14x & 30m>7x; 30m>7x & 2h>3x | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-hosted-api-chat?var-region=us-east-1 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Hosted-API | default | Latency-only requires 10m persistence + no known upstream provider outage.

hosted_api.chat.eu-west-1 | Prometheus (gateway) | same as above (region=eu-west-1) | error_rate >= 1.0% for 5m OR p95_latency_ms >= 2.5x baseline for 10m | error_rate >= 5.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 25% for 3m | same | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-hosted-api-chat?var-region=eu-west-1 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Hosted-API | default | Coordinate with Routing (Mina) on cross-region spillover.

hosted_api.chat.us-west-2 | Prometheus (gateway) | same | error_rate >= 1.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 5.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 25% for 3m | same | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-hosted-api-chat?var-region=us-west-2 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Hosted-API | default | 

hosted_api.streaming.us-east-1 | Prometheus (streaming) | streaming_disconnect_rate = disconnects/streams_started | disconnect_rate >= 0.8% for 5m OR stream_error_rate >= 1.0% for 5m | disconnect_rate >= 3.0% for 5m OR stream_error_rate >= 5.0% for 5m | disconnect_rate >= 10% for 3m OR streams_started drops > 50% vs 30m baseline | 5m>14x & 30m>7x (streaming availability SLO) | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-streaming?var-region=us-east-1 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Streaming | override: resolve_after=15m; cooldown=20m | Streaming tends to flap during transient network events; be conservative on auto-resolve.

hosted_api.streaming.eu-west-1 | Prometheus (streaming) | same (region=eu-west-1) | disconnect_rate >= 0.8% for 5m | disconnect_rate >= 3.0% for 5m | disconnect_rate >= 10% for 3m | same | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-streaming?var-region=eu-west-1 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Streaming | override: resolve_after=15m | 

hosted_api.embeddings.us-east-1 | Prometheus (gateway) | api_gateway_requests_total{capability="embeddings",region="us-east-1"} + errors | error_rate >= 1.0% for 5m OR p95_latency_ms >= 3.0x baseline for 10m | error_rate >= 7.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 30% for 3m | burn-rate (embeddings SLO): 5m>14x & 30m>7x | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-embeddings?var-region=us-east-1 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Embeddings | default | NOTE: classification bug fixed in redwood/pr-19563; ensure mapping uses capability tag, not route prefix.

hosted_api.embeddings.eu-west-1 | Prometheus (gateway) | same | error_rate >= 1.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 7.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 30% for 3m | same | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-embeddings?var-region=eu-west-1 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Embeddings | default | 

hosted_api.rerank.us-east-1 | Prometheus (gateway) | api_gateway_requests_total{capability="rerank",region="us-east-1"} + errors | error_rate >= 1.5% for 5m OR p95_latency_ms >= 3.0x baseline for 10m | error_rate >= 8.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 30% for 3m | burn-rate (rerank SLO): 5m>14x & 30m>7x | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-rerank?var-region=us-east-1 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Reranking | default | Rerank traffic lower QPS; enforce minQPS before auto-major-outage.

hosted_api.rerank.eu-west-1 | Prometheus (gateway) | same | error_rate >= 1.5% for 5m | error_rate >= 8.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 30% for 3m | same | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-rerank?var-region=eu-west-1 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Reranking | default | 

hosted_api.model_router.global | Prometheus (router) + logs | routing_failure_rate, fallback_active_ratio | fallback_active_ratio >= 15% for 10m OR routing_failure_rate >= 0.5% for 5m | routing_failure_rate >= 2.0% for 5m OR fallback_active_ratio >= 40% for 10m | routing_failure_rate >= 10% for 3m | burn-rate (routing SLO): 5m>14x & 30m>7x | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-router | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Routing | override: trigger_after=10m for fallback-only | Fallback activation may be intentional mitigation; comms should clarify “serving via fallback models” if applicable.

console.web.global | Synthetic checks + RUM | console_uptime_synth, http_5xx_rate, login_error_rate | synth availability < 99% for 10m OR 5xx_rate >= 1% for 10m | synth availability < 97% for 5m OR 5xx_rate >= 5% for 5m | synth availability < 90% for 3m | burn-rate (console SLO): 30m>7x & 2h>3x | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-console | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Console | override: trigger_after=10m; cooldown=30m | Console incidents should not be used to infer Hosted API health.

console.incident-links.global | Console backend | status_incident_link_errors_total / requests | error_rate >= 1.0% for 10m | error_rate >= 5.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 20% for 3m | N/A (feature SLO) | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-console-links | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Console | default | This is for “linking to status incidents/summaries” integration; optional component depending on layout decision.

dedicated.control_plane.global | Prometheus (control plane) | provisioning_error_rate + config_propagation_lag_seconds | provisioning_error_rate >= 2% for 10m OR p95_propagation_lag >= 10m for 15m | provisioning_error_rate >= 10% for 10m OR p95_propagation_lag >= 30m for 10m | provisioning_error_rate >= 30% for 5m OR control plane unavailable | burn-rate (dedicated CP SLO): 30m>7x & 2h>3x | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-dedicated-cp | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Dedicated | override: manual_review_required=true for major outage | Dedicated CP often impacts subset of customers; status messaging must avoid customer-specific callouts.

dedicated.routing-updates.global | Prometheus (scheduler/agent) | route_push_failure_rate | failure_rate >= 1% for 15m | failure_rate >= 5% for 10m | failure_rate >= 20% for 5m | N/A | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-dedicated-routing | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Dedicated | override: trigger_after=15m | Used for “control-plane signals” only; runtime issues for dedicated clusters should be handled per customer process unless widespread.

statuspage.delivery.global | Statuspage API client logs | publish_failures_total + render_latency | publish_failures >= 3 in 10m OR render_latency_p95 >= 3s for 10m | publish_failures >= 10 in 10m | Statuspage unavailable | N/A | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-statuspage-delivery | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Statuspage | default | Meta-component: ensures we can actually post updates; escalate to Comms Lead + IC if blocked.

hosted_api.auth.global | Prometheus (auth) | oauth_token_errors + api_key_validation_errors | error_rate >= 0.5% for 5m | error_rate >= 2.0% for 5m | error_rate >= 10% for 3m | burn-rate (auth SLO): 5m>14x & 30m>7x | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-auth | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Auth | default | This can present as “everything failing” even when inference runtime healthy.

hosted_api.uploads.us-east-1 | Prometheus (object store proxy) | upload_5xx_rate + timeouts | 5xx_rate >= 1% for 10m | 5xx_rate >= 5% for 5m | 5xx_rate >= 20% for 3m | N/A | Grafana: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/status-uploads?var-region=us-east-1 | Confluence: status-page-update-runbook#Hosted-API | default | Only relevant if we expose file upload / fine-tune artifacts to hosted endpoints (confirm taxonomy).

Tab: Alert routing (summary)
- Component burn-rate alerts route to: SRE on-call (primary), Observability (secondary) with runbook link + component_id context.
- Streaming disconnect alerts route to: Runtime on-call + SRE on-call.
- Console synth alerts route to: Product Console on-call + SRE (FYI) during business hours.

Open questions / TODO (as of 2025-11-21)
1) Latency-only “degraded performance” criteria: confirm baseline calculation (rolling 7d p95?) and exclusion windows (deploys).
2) Minimum QPS gating: define minQPS per component so low-traffic regions don’t auto-flap (proposal: min 20 rpm for major outage, 200 rpm for partial outage).
3) Dedicated/Private: ensure we don’t over-generalize; policy likely: only publish Dedicated-wide CP incidents; runtime issues remain customer-scoped unless multi-tenant / broad.
4) Anti-flap overrides for EU West during maintenance windows (routing spillover).
5) Ensure all dashboard links exist + match naming conventions (blocked on observability-pack/pr-19277 rollout).

Change log
- 2025-11-07: added streaming disconnect_rate thresholds after US East streaming degradation postmortem.
- 2025-11-12: adjusted default resolve_after to 10m (was 5m) to reduce flapping.
- 2025-11-18: added explicit note re: embeddings misclassification fix (redwood/pr-19563).
- 2025-11-21: added statuspage.delivery meta-component and manual_review_required for Dedicated CP major-outage state.
